title: Pre-flight assessment in the core
goal: The core answers whether the fleet is ready to fly, deterministically
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the pre-flight check plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok" and "real" data).

A pure function in the core takes the fleet state and the clock and returns the F-024-T01 result: batteries ready, needing a storage charge, with a check due; drones flagged after a crash or with a damaged part; spares low; no randomness and no model call; the clock is a parameter
Specs with invented data cover each verdict, an empty fleet (empty sections, not an error), a battery both low and due a check, and the F-024-T01 failing test now passes
privacy: Invented data only (neutral drone, battery and spare names); no owner data, secrets or export files in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one pure function over the existing battery, fleet and spares operations, plus specs. Not a measurement.
